results.summary: This design plays the Super Mario theme tune through a piezo speaker using differential PWM modulation. It converts an RTTL ringtone into Verilog and outputs the sound wave on uio_out[1:0]. A 100kHz clock is provided on the clk pin, and a brief reset on rst_n starts playback. A piezo speaker connected across uio_out[1:0] is required for audible output.
This design implements a neural network on chip. Drive inputs to [7:0] ui_in and the result of the computation can be observed on [7:0] uo_out. The design is a neural network accelerator.

This design is a stack-machine CPU written in SystemVerilog. It uses a single data pin for input, output, and bidirectional communication. The design can be tested in hardware or simulation. The documentation is very sparse, offering only a one-line description and no further details on the instruction set or operation.

This design includes timer, interrupt-controller, counter, and clock-divider functionality. It is a timer and counter design with interrupt support. The documentation does not provide silicon test results.
This design is a music and sound generator that outputs audio through PWM. It requires an analog PWM filter and audio driver for the test rig. The design generates sound signals.
This design is a clock generator and display driver. It uses a 7-segment display and includes timer and button inputs. The design also includes a real-time clock (RTC) functionality.

This design is a counter with FSM and sensor interface. It drives a 7-segment display and includes an up-down counter. The documentation explains the state machine logic but does not include silicon test results.
This design performs matrix multiplication. The first input switch, when flipped, initializes a matrix multiplication between the current set of inputs. It is a machine learning accelerator.

This design is an accelerator for neural networks, specifically a spiking neural network. It uses fixed-point arithmetic. The documentation provides a detailed protocol for testing but does not include silicon results.
This design is a chip tune synthesizer that generates music. It uses PWM and UART interfaces. The design is a sound generator.
